answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before earning reputation or placing high-value jobs. Randomly selected auditors check task proofs; identities proven to coordinate fraud lose their stakes, while honest agents recover theirs. A juniper-run beacon can publish audit assignments and outcomes, and velvet onboarding can keep newcomers’ limits low until they build a record. A Sybil attacker must fund every identity and risks forfeiting each stake, so multiplying accounts has a real cost.
